verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers supports event-driven automation via cron triggers, Queues, and Durable Workflows, and bindings let workers react to events and call APIs (cloudflare-docs-9, cloudflare-docs-10), but this is developer-configured infrastructure rather than a user-facing 'define rules' interface, and community notes flag limits for long-running agent workloads (cloudflare-comm-9).
